game.title: Crusader Kings III
game.blurb: Medieval grand strategy and role-playing game from Paradox Development Studio, released 2020-09-01. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: RPG, Strategy, Simulation. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Dynasty, Family and Rule
chapters.summary: Base game goals: marriage, children, lifestyles, dynasty legacies, prestige, piety, dread, stress, schemes, hooks, faiths and holy orders.

chapters.title: Historic Starts and Realm Goals
chapters.summary: Base game goals tied to a starting ruler, start date, faith or region, such as forming kingdoms, restoring empires and playing until 1453.

chapters.title: Norse Rulers and the Iberian Struggle
chapters.summary: Asatru and North Germanic goals, rune stones and Varangian adventures, then the Iberian struggle, Basque faith and Valencia.

chapters.title: Royal Courts, Artifacts and Culture
chapters.summary: Court grandeur, artifacts, inspirations, court languages, and hybrid or divergent cultures.

chapters.title: Travel, Tournaments, Hunts and Weddings
chapters.summary: Grand tours, pilgrimages, jousts and tournaments, hunts, feasts and grand weddings.

chapters.title: The Iranian Struggle, Legends and Epidemics
chapters.summary: The Iranian Intermezzo struggle, viziers and caliphates, then legends, legitimacy and epidemics such as the plague.

chapters.title: Adventurers, Estates and Byzantium
chapters.summary: Landless adventurers and camp followers, administrative government, great families, estates and themes in Byzantium.

chapters.title: The Steppe, China, Japan and Mandala Realms
chapters.summary: Nomads, tributaries and confederations on the Steppe, then the Mandate of Heaven, exams and merit in China, Japan and mandala rulers.

chapters.title: Popes, Cardinals and the Church
chapters.summary: Puppet popes, antipopes, cardinals, archbishops, ecumenical councils and relics.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1158310)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom unavailable (no page under this title), marked unverified
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Strategy game, so chapters follow the content groups the achievements show rather than a story. None of the 198 Steam achievements is hidden. Their Steam API names carry prefixes that look like add-on codenames (fp1, fp2, fp3, ep1 to ep4, ce1, ce3 and mpo, with no prefix for the 56 base-game ones); chapters group achievements by those prefixes by exact name and are titled from what their descriptions talk about, because the add-on names themselves were not in the fetched data. Pairs merged to stay within 9 chapters: fp1 with fp2, fp3 with ce1, mpo with ep4. Base-game achievements are split by description: those that begin "Starting as" or "As ..." (except "As any one character"), plus restoring the Roman Empire and playing until 1453, go to the historic starts chapter. StrategyWiki has no page under "Crusader Kings III" or "Crusader Kings 3". On Fandom, ck3.fandom.com returns HTTP 404 and crusaderkings.fandom.com answers the API but has no "Crusader Kings III" page, so Fandom is marked unverified. RAWG spells the developer "Paradox Developement Studios".
